Great Lakes Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Schlumberger (SLB) by 6.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 1.11 million shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $74.49 million, down from 1.18 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Great Lakes Advisors Llc who had been investing in Schlumberger for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $99.18B market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $71.6. About 5.14 million shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
Coldstream Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Micron Technology Inc (MU) by 104.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Coldstream Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $61.47B market cap company.
